Metapod?! |pokemonname=Omastar |current=[[Party|With Yellow]] |va=no }} '''Omny''' (Japanese: '''オムすけ''' ''Omsuke''), known as '''Omask''' in [[Chuang Yi]]'s translation of the {{MangaArc|FireRed & LeafGreen}}, is an {{p|Omastar}} that {{adv|Yellow}} owns in [[Pokémon Adventures]]. Yellow was given Omny as a {{pkmn2|gift}} from [[Misty]]; he is her fifth {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} overall. As of ''[[PS290|A Well-Journeyed Jumpluff]]'', he is at [[level]] 42, and his [[Characteristic]] is that he is "somewhat vain." ==History== ==={{MangaArc|Yellow}}=== ====With Misty==== Omny first appeared as an Omanyte in ''[[PS049|As Gastly as Before]]'', being sent out by [[Misty]] to try and pull down {{tc|Super Nerd}} {{adv|Miles}} from a sinister black fog. The dark fog reveals itself to be a {{p|Gastly}} and shakes him off. After the Gastly is defeated by {{adv|Blue}}, Misty {{pkmn2|gift|gives}} Omanyte to {{adv|Yellow}} so she can better protect herself. ====With Yellow==== [[File:Yellow and Omny.png|thumb|200px|left|Omny and Yellow]] In ''[[PS056|The Coming of Slowpoke (Eventually)]]'', Omny used {{m|Ice Beam}} to seal a hole in the sinking [[S.S. Anne]]. He [[PS057|later]] used Ice Beam to {{status|freeze}} the legs of the [[Team Rocket Elite Trio]], Ken, Al, and Harry and their {{p|Hypno}}, preventing it from attacking Yellow's team. [[File:Yellow battling Lance.png|thumb|175px|Omny battling Lance]] In ''[[PS082|Eradicate Raticate!]]'', Omny is sent out alongside his teammates to battle against [[Lance]] and his {{TP|Lance|Dragonite}}. Omny attacks with a powerful {{m|Water Gun}}, but {{p|Dragonite}} simply shrugs it off and throws Omny away. He is [[PS087|later]] used in a team attack to try and stop Lance from shooting bubbles. Yellow had [[Kitty]] cover the volcano crater in {{m|String Shot}} to form a net that is doused by Omny's water, linked to [[Ratty]]'s sensitive whiskers. Upon Lance triggering the net, Ratty signals to [[Pika]] to send electricity down the net, forcing Lance's bubble into view. Yellow then orders [[Dody]] to break the bubble with {{m|Drill Peck}}, but the attack proves too weak. In the final battle against Lance in ''[[PS089|The Might of... Metapod?!]]'', after Yellow had lost the [[Pokédex]], Omny [[Evolution|evolves]] into an Omastar to gain more power. He then assisted in defeating Lance's team, attacking his Dragonite with an Ice Beam. ==={{MangaArc|Gold, Silver & Crystal}}=== In ''[[PS152|Buzz Off, Butterfree!]]'', Omny used {{m|Hydro Pump}} to put out a fire at the [[Burned Tower]]. In ''[[PS173|The Last Battle VII]]'', Omny was seen defending the {{pkmn|Day Care}} Center with the rest of her Pokémon from the half-masked {{tc|Team Rocket Grunt}}s. ==={{MangaArc|FireRed & LeafGreen}}=== In ''[[PS290|A Well-Journeyed Jumpluff]]'', Omny battled [[Orm]] and his {{p|Jumpluff}}. Due to the spores that Jumpluff released, it made it near impossible to release a Pokémon without getting a [[status condition]]. Using her telepathic abilities Yellow moved Omny's {{i|Poké Ball}} outside the spores' range. Once past, Yellow released Omny and had him freeze Jumpluff with {{m|Blizzard}}. The attack also froze the spores as well, causing them all to fall to the ground. In ''[[PS302|Phew for Mew]]'', Omny and Yellow found themselves petrified by [[Sird]], along with the four other [[Pokédex holder]]s and their Pokémon. ==={{MangaArc|Emerald}}=== In ''[[PS334|The Final Battle VII]]'', Yellow checked on Omny and the rest of her team to ensure they all survived the petrification caused by {{adv|Mewtwo}} and {{p|Darkrai}}. ==Personality and characteristics== When {{adv|Yellow}} first got Omny, he was aggressive towards her, [[Obedience|ignoring]] her commands and attacking her. This was due to the fact that he originally belonged to a powerful [[Gym Leader]] and Yellow had yet to prove herself to him. Over time, however, the two managed to develop a loving relationship, and now, Omny follows his {{pkmn|Trainer}}'s commands without hesitation.
